name: EPIC 213410543

text.card: A red giant 7,725 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.83 solar masses and 19.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,976 K at its surface.
